source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Norwegian written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. Facts about Norway and Bergen are general knowledge and unchecked. review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "Unnskyld" opens a request to a stranger. "Gå rett fram" is the standard instruction for "go straight ahead".

sentences.text: Sam er på busstoppet. Han vil til sentrum.
sentences.english: Sam is at the bus stop. He wants to go to the town centre.
The bus is coming. Sam is happy.
Excuse me, does the bus go to the town centre?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.english: Yes, it goes to the town centre.
sentences.speaker: sjafor

sentences.english: How much does it cost?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.english: It costs forty kroner.
sentences.speaker: sjafor

sentences.english: Here is the money. Thanks.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.english: Here you are.
sentences.speaker: sjafor

sentences.english: Sam likes the town from the window.

sentences.text: Han liker kirka, skolen og markedet. Det regner litt.
sentences.english: He likes the church, the school and the market. It is raining a little.
Does it stop here?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.english: Yes, it stops here.
sentences.speaker: sjafor

sentences.text: Den stopper bare litt. Mange folk går ut. Alle går ut, og Sam går ut også.
sentences.english: It stops only a little. Many people get out. Everyone gets out, and Sam gets out too.
Thank you very much! Goodbye!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.english: Goodbye!
sentences.speaker: sjafor

sentences.text: Sam er i byen. Han vil til klinikken. Anna jobber på klinikken.
sentences.english: Sam is in town. He wants to go to the clinic. Anna works at the clinic.
Excuse me, where is the clinic?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Gå rett fram. Så går du til høyre.
sentences.english: Go straight ahead. Then you turn right.
sentences.speaker: dame

sentences.english: Straight ahead and to the right?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.english: Yes, that is right.
sentences.speaker: dame

sentences.english: Thank you very much!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.english: You are welcome!
sentences.speaker: dame

sentences.text: Sam går rett fram. Så går han til høyre.
sentences.english: Sam goes straight ahead. Then he turns right.
Excuse me, is this the clinic?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, hei, Sam! Her er klinikken.
sentences.english: Yes, hi, Sam! Here is the clinic.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Hvordan går det? Du er i byen i dag!
sentences.english: How are you? You are in town today!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, jeg er her. Jeg vil ha litt kaffe.
sentences.english: Yes, I am here. I want a little coffee.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bra! Vil du ha kaffe nå?
sentences.english: Good! Do you want coffee now?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne! Du jobber mye, Anna.
sentences.english: Yes, please! You work a lot, Anna.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, jeg er trøtt i dag. Men jeg er glad.
sentences.english: Yes, I am tired today. But I am glad.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Anna har kaffe og brød. Sam er glad.
sentences.english: Anna has coffee and bread. Sam is happy.

sentences.text: Sam er på bussen, og han vil ha middag. Han vil ha fisk og poteter. Marta lager suppe.
sentences.english: Sam is on the bus, and he wants dinner. He wants fish and potatoes. Marta makes soup.

sentences.text: Nils er elev. Skolen begynner klokka åtte. Han har lekse, men han liker ikke å skrive.
sentences.english: Nils is a pupil. School begins at eight o'clock. He has homework, but he does not like to write.

sentences.text: Presten leser i bibelen, og alle synger en sang.
sentences.english: The pastor reads in the Bible, and everyone sings a song.

sentences.text: Anna er sykepleier, og hun tar bussen til klinikken.
sentences.english: Anna is a nurse, and she takes the bus to the clinic.
